issues.explanation: The invite form validates inviteEmail but never renders its error, so a validation failure on the invite e-mail shows zero help is-danger elements instead of exactly one.
No route file is changed in the diff, so entity.members route-level manager-only protection is missing even though the Livewire mount now authorizes update.

The diff adds no Pest/PHPUnit tests and touches no existing tests, despite new Livewire actions, mail, model, factory and authorization rules that require happy-path, validation, unauthorized and tamper tests.
Domain writes (sendInvite, accept/decline, saveRole, removeMember) use Eloquent directly in Livewire components instead of app/Actions/* one-class-per-use-case with authorization inside.
Livewire validation uses inline $this->validate([...]) with no #[Validate] attributes on inviteEmail/inviteRole/memberRole, diverging from the project's #[Validate] + $this->validate() pattern.
No docs, business-rules, database-schema, or CHANGELOG update accompanies the new table, mailer, and UI flows.
Server-controlled state selectedMembershipId/confirmingRemoval/memberRole is public without #[Locked], and cancelRemoval/closeMember perform state changes with no authorization check.
The invite e-mail renders the expiry twice on adjacent lines, including a raw duplicate date line alongside the translated sentence.

conventions.evidence: No app/Actions/* for invite/member writes; inline $this->validate([...]) without #[Validate] (Members.php:sendInvite,saveRole); no docs/CHANGELOG changes despite 17-file feature. Migration has reversible down() (2026_10_29_000000_create_entity_invites_table.php:648-651) and audit Log::channel('audit') is kept.

readability.evidence:
Clear names (sendInvite, cancelInvite, openMember, saveRole, PendingInvites::accept/decline), small focused methods, modal header exactly

{{ __('ui.members_details') }}

(members.blade.php:979); sendInvite is long and email view has duplicate expiry line.

requirements.evidence: Met: entity_invites schema/unique/cascade (migration:631-641), EntityInvite normalization/casts/pending (EntityInvite.php:523-548), sendInvite duplicate/pending/race/rate-limit/mail/audit (Members.php:66-163), PendingInvites accept/decline/idempotent/redirect (PendingInvites.php:317-402), modals and lang keys. Missing: no @error('inviteEmail') in members.blade.php:860-894 (only inviteRole), no routes/* change for entity.members manager-only route.

scope.evidence: All 17 changed files serve invites/manager-only members (model, factory, migration, mail, views, lang, switcher/onboarding includes); dashboard/layout changes only hide members links from non-managers; extra closeMember() still serves the modal.

security.evidence: Sensitive actions authorize update/assignRole and scope lookups via entity->memberships()/invites() and invitee email abort_unless 403 (Members.php:68,165,184,201; PendingInvites.php:326-329); mass-assignment via #[Fillable], {{ }} escaping, rate-limit hit only on success. Gaps with limited impact: selectedMembershipId not #[Locked], cancelRemoval/closeMember lack authorize.

simplicity.evidence: Reuses mail::message theme, existing policies/audit, pending() scope and factory; no service layers or speculative abstraction. Extra closeMember() beyond contract and duplicate expiry line in emails/entity-invite.blade.php:782-783 add small duplication.

tests.evidence: grep for tests/Pest/PHPUnit in change.diff returns nothing; diff file list contains no tests/*, no factory-adjacent feature tests, no unauthorized/tamper tests for sendInvite/cancelInvite/openMember/saveRole/accept/decline.

review.summary: The change implements the invite model, mailer, PendingInvites flows and manager-only members UI with correct authorization scoping and rate limiting. It cannot be approved because the invite e-mail validation error is never rendered, the entity.members route protection is absent, and no tests ship with the new behavior.
